translations.literal: Empress Qinren, Consort of Taizong, was of the Tangkuo clan.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Qinren, consort of Emperor Taizong, was of the Tangkuo clan.

translations.zh: 熙宗即位，與太祖欽憲皇后俱尊為太皇太后，號明德宮。
translations.literal: When Xizong took the throne, she and Empress Qinxian, Consort of Taizu, were both honored as grand empress dowagers; her palace was named Mingde.
translations.idiomatic: When Xizong ascended the throne, she and Empress Qinxian of Taizu were both honored as grand empresses dowager, with the palace name Mingde.

translations.zh: 贈后父阿魯束太尉、宋國公，祖寬匹司徒、英國公，曾祖阿魯瑣司空、溫國公。
translations.literal: Her father Alushu was posthumously granted Grand Marshal and Duke of Song; her grandfather Kuanpi was granted Minister of Education and Duke of Ying; her great-grandfather Alusuo was granted Minister of Works and Duke of Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Alushu was posthumously made Grand Marshal and Duke of Song; her grandfather Kuanpi was made Minister of Education and Duke of Ying; her great-grandfather Alusuo was made Minister of Works and Duke of Wen.

translations.zh: 十四年正月己巳朔，上朝兩宮太后，然後御乾元殿受賀，自後歲以為常。
translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, on jisi, the first day of the first month, the emperor paid court to the two palaces of the empress dowagers, then proceeded to Qianyuan Hall to receive congratulations; thereafter this became the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, New Year's Day in the fourteenth year, the emperor paid court to the two empresses dowager, then took the throne at Qianyuan Hall to receive congratulations; thereafter this became an annual rite.

translations.zh: 皇統元年，上自燕京還京師，朝謁于明德宮。
translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong, the emperor returned to the capital from Yanjing and paid homage at Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Huangtong reign the emperor returned from Yanjing to the capital and paid homage at Mingde Palace.

translations.zh: 明年，上如天開殿，皇子生，使使馳報太后。
translations.literal: The next year the emperor went to the Tian Kai Hall; a prince was born, and he dispatched envoys at full speed to report to the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the emperor went to the Tian Kai Hall; when a prince was born, he sent envoys posthaste to inform the empress dowager.

translations.zh: 太后至大開殿，上與皇后親迎之。
translations.literal: The empress dowager came to the Da Kai Hall, and the emperor and empress personally went out to welcome her.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager came to the Da Kai Hall, and the emperor and empress went out in person to welcome her.

translations.literal: In the third year she died at Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year she died at Mingde Palace.

translations.zh: 諡曰欽仁皇后，祔葬恭陵。
translations.literal: Her posthumous title was Empress Qinren; she was enshrined and buried at Gongling.
translations.idiomatic: She was given the posthumous title Empress Qinren and was enshrined and buried at Gongling.
